message: After the exhibition match with Victoria ended, we all headed to the cafe inside the academy.

name: Iori
message: 「Victoria, thanks for joining us today. I think the whole Takamura Class learned a lot because of it.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah, yeah! I had a super fun time, too!」

name: Iori
message: 「So, my treat today. Everyone, feel free to order whatever you want.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay! Teacher, you’re so generous!」

name: Victoria
message: 「I want cake! I want to order cake!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um, excuse me, I’m sorry for Vicky’s behavior...」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, don’t worry about it. It’s fine. Shizuku, you should order something you like, too.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Oh, t-thank you very much!」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, could you gather everyone’s orders and go place them？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yes, yes~! Consider it done!」
Setsugekka ran around between everyone, asking for their orders.

name: Victoria
message: 「But really, the Takamura Class, I’d heard the rumors, but you’re amazing！ Everyone was just so excellent！」

name: Victoria
message: 「It only ended up being Kuki-chan today, but I really wanted to fight everyone else too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way, even after you were rampaging around like that！ Your stamina really is monstrous...」

name: Iori
message: 「Victoria was amazing too, but I was surprised, Shizuku, because you were stronger than I expected.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yup! Shizu is super strong. Right, Shizu!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「N-no, I’m not all that...！ I’m sorry...」

name: Victoria
message: 「The suppleness of the muscles hidden in that slender body... I can tell just by touching it!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky...！ I-it’s not good to make it sound like you’re always touching me！」

name: Iori
message: 「There aren't many people in the Technical Division who can do as much as you can.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「P-please don’t praise me so much...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Everyone~, sorry to keep you waiting~! Look, look, it’s a mountain of sweets!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s here, it’s here！ I’m having the cream anmitsu！」

name: Momiji
message: 「H-hey, isn't there way too much here？」

name: Iori
message: 「No matter how you look at it, there are more than ten dishes here...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I didn't meff up or anyfin'~♪ *Nom*, I counted properly when I ordered」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, that's very bad manners」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, everyone, don't hold back and dig in」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「*Nom, nom*... Mmm~, this exquisite harmony of cream and red bean paste！ It's so good~♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Secchan, you really can eat~. Mine might be a bit too much for me. Want the rest？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Really？ Gimme, gimme~！ Leaving sweets uneaten is an outrage, after all！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Good girl, good girl~. Eat it all up without leaving a bite, okay~？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Woof, woof, whine~」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Staaaaare...」
For some reason, Shizuku-san was staring intently at Setsugekka being happily fed by Ririmu.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh? Could it be that you want some too, Shizuku-senpai?」

name: Shizuku
message: 「E-Eh? No, um... it's not like that...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, there's still plenty of this left, so go right ahead and eat it~！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um... are you sure？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Of course! Sweets are meant to be shared with all humankind! So please, don't hesitate~♪」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I'm so happy... Th-Thank you very much！」
Accepting the cream anmitsu from Setsugekka, she immediately began eating.

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizu just loves sweet things, you know♪ She gets super happy whenever you give her manjuu as a gift~」

name: Shizuku
message: 「S-So sweet...♪ Oh, this is bliss... *nom*. I really, truly love sweets...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I totally get that feeling~！ I crave sweets like crazy after a match too~, *nom, nom*」

name: Asahi
message: 「Isn't that 365 days a year for you, Setsugekka-san？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Iori-sensei~, these gluttons won't stooop」

name: Iori
message: 「Leave them be. Let's leave the rest to Shizuku-san and Setsugekka」
They look happy, so I might as well let them enjoy themselves to their hearts' content.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Got it, loud and clear! Leave it to me~!」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehe, the Takamura Class is full of such fun kids~♪」
When Victoria laughs, Shizuku also smiles shyly.

name: Iori
message: 「You and Shizuku are really close, Victoria. Are you two always together?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah, pretty much. Right, Shizu？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes, I suppose so.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alrighty, can I ask how you two met?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, you want the story, huh？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「H-how we met? That’s… not really…」

name: Victoria
message: 「See, Shizu participated in last year’s Martial Festival and was winning with incredible momentum.」

name: Victoria
message: 「But then she withdrew halfway through. I was so curious about that, I just had to go see her.」

name: Victoria
message: 「And then she goes and says she only entered the Martial Festival for data collection！ I mean, like, whyyy, right?」

name: Victoria
message: 「Anyway, as we kept talking, we became friends, and she started tuning my Origami.」

name: Iori
message: 「So that’s how you managed to secure the title of Toujinegi, Victoria.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Exactly！ I got so much stronger thanks to Shizu！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「It’s not really thanks to me. It’s just that you were already strong to begin with, Vicky.」
Shizuku fidgets and looks down.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「By the way, what school of swordsmanship do you practice, Victoria-senpai？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yeah, I’m Tennen Rishin-ryuu, the school that makes even crying children go silent！」

name: Victoria
message: 「...Or that’s what I’d like to say, but I actually mix a lot of things. I guess it’s a self-styled variation based on Tennen Rishin-ryuu right now~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, come to think of it, you do say that when you use your special move-looking technique, Victoria-senpai.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「‘Our Tennen Rishin-ryuu is the number one sword style under the heavens！’」

name: Victoria
message: 「Exactly, ‘Our Tennen Rishin-ryuu is the number one sword style under the heavens！’」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahahaha, this is fun.」

name: Victoria
message: 「It is, isn't it~！」

name: Momiji
message: 「No, isn't that embarrassing...?」
W-Well, it's probably fine, just a little.

name: Victoria
message: 「My favorite is 'Okita-kun,' you know, so I've gotta show some respect!」

name: Victoria
message: 「I even paid respect to it in my Origami's name!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh~, what is it called？」

name: Victoria
message: 「<d0068>Ultimate Kikuichimonji Sword Kai</d>！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-Ultimate...！？ That's so cooool！ Truly worthy of the Toujinegi！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I wanna come up with a cool name too~. I'm starting to feel like Momijigari really is kinda lame.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Took you long enough to notice~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The 'Momiji' part in particular is lame, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Fufufu, do you want to die？」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well, well... setting the name aside」

name: Iori
message: 「The base model is <d0069>SUMITANI</d>'s 'Ichimonji Shin,' right?」
I like Origami parts myself and read up on them, so I can more or less tell.
Victoria-san's Origami uses parts from a Jindou brand called SUMITANI.

name: Iori
message: 「Still, both the internals and the design have been heavily modified. You could practically call it a whole different thing.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Y-Yes, that's right! Amazing, you're the first person to see through that Origami's traits at a single glance!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「U-Um...! If you'd like, shall I explain it in detail？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. I'd love to hear it.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Let's see... As you know, the high-spec series 'FUKUOKA' boasts such high performance that it doesn't even need any fine-tuning.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「On the flip side, the price is extremely steep, so most students can't get their hands on one. Taking that situation into account, SUMITANI created the 'Ichimonji Shin.' Of course its specs are inferior, but its great balance is its selling point！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Because it was created by ripping o—no, paying respect to the best parts of the FUKUOKA as a base, it's both affordable and high-performance. It's even used frequently for practice at dojos...」

name: Shizuku
message: 「So I figure that made it easier for Vicky to acquire as well. Besides, speaking of Ichimonji, that's Okita-kun's beloved sword, you know. You could call it the very crystallization of her love for Okita-kun.」
Shizuku-san, launching into her explanation with tremendous momentum.

name: Shizuku
message: "Its performance still fell short for a grueling tournament, so I overhauled and reforged it from scratch—upgrading its strength, toughness, and Tenju properties..."

name: Shizuku
message: 「That's how I created this special custom Ultimate Kikuichimonji Sword Kai! Do you see what I mean?!」

name: Iori
message: 「O-Ohhh...」
Everyone was completely overwhelmed by the sheer intensity with which the usually quiet Shizuku-san had started talking.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ah, I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry... I got a little too carried away...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Don't worry about it, Shizuku-senpai!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I talk a ton when I'm gushing about stuff I like too, y'know? Everyone's like that.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Th-Thank you...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「In exchange, listen to me talk too, okay? I wanna start my own Jindou brand someday!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I bet more design-forward, fashionable Origami are gonna become super popular from now on！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Th-That sounds fascinating...！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoaaa, Shizuku-senpai took the bait...」
For the next thirty minutes or so, the two of them got completely absorbed in talking about Origami parts and Jindou brands.

name: Iori
message: 「Victoria-san, Shizuku-san, thank you so much for today. It was a lot of fun and really inspiring.」

name: Victoria
message: 「No problem at all♪ Let's hang out again sometime！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「I had a wonderful time as well. Thank you.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Oh, in the future I'm planning to form a pro Jindou team. If you've got any strong fighters, definitely send them our way!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Vicky, aren't you getting a little ahead of yourself?」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, if you want to scout anyone from Takamura Class, make sure you go through me.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Hehe, okay！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, before all that, first up is the Martial Festival, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Totally! We're all rivals, after all!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm gonna win! I'll win and win and definitely become Toujinegi! Oh, and I'm definitely gonna take down Momimomi!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, I may have lost in today's practice match, but next time won't go the same way.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I will win, and I'll be taking the title of Toujinegi for myself.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yes, bring it ooon！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Mmm, I'm getting all fired up！ Let's train hard tomorrow too♪」
Some quietly stoked their fighting spirit. Others traded sparks right along with her. Everyone reacted in their own way.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let's call it a day！」
The match against the current Toujinegi got everyone's spirits running high. Let's keep this momentum going and give it our all for the Martial Festival.
